description: A short check for all staff at Carrholme Services, a fictional company, taken before the awareness episodes (pair BA). Ten items from a Carrholme inbox and phone: emails and a call about data and conduct. The result is kept so the matching final check can show how the two compare.
organiser_note: each role's check tests the channel that role meets in its episode, and in a session that runs more than one episode only the learner's primary-role check is recorded.
